svg.text: Loop-token share per training step: cross-train (splice) runs with their associated arms
share = tokens inside repetitive reasoning blocks (block ≥ 1,000 tokens, zlib ratio < 0.10) / all generated tokens of the step's rollouts. Splice runs start from the
base model. chain P/chain Q: steps 1-20 train on chain M's recorded rollouts instead of generating, live generation with their own engine from step 21; chain R/chain X: steps
1-10 train on chain G's recorded rollouts instead of generating, live generation with their own engine from step 11; chain R′: steps 1-16 train on chain G's recorded rollouts
instead of generating, live generation with their own engine from step 17; chain AA: only chain G steps 8-10 replayed, live on the other steps; chain P′: weights frozen at
chain P step 20 (lr = 0), MINF generation from step 21; chain Q′: weights frozen at chain P step 20 (lr = 0), vLLM generation from step 21; chain P‴: chain P step 20 resumed
with normal training (lr 3e-6, optimizer state loaded), MINF generation with the prefix cache KEPT across weight updates (invalidate_prefix_cache_on_weight_update=false),
nvshmem refit, live from step 21 (chain P: MINF, chain Q: vLLM, chain R: vLLM, chain R′: vLLM, chain P′: MINF, chain Q′: vLLM, chain P‴: MINF, chain X: vLLM, chain AA: vLLM).
Solid = MINF-generated, dashed = vLLM-generated; grey = replayed source data. Comparator arms are clipped at step 50; their full history is in loopshare_all_table.svg.

svg.text: value equals the source arm's by construction
Table: loop-token share (%) by step and arm

r = replayed step (grey): the splice run trained on its source arm's recorded rollouts for this step and generated nothing, so the value equals the source arm's by construction and only checks the tooling.
Live steps are the experiment. * = partial step (fewer than 512 rollouts) or a step never checkpointed (chain J step 13). Blank = no data.
Column shading = eval outcome of the arm: green ✓ eval good, red ✗ eval bad (SWE-Bench Verified pass@1); yellow ? presumed bad and light blue ? presumed good = not yet evaluated, called from the loop
trajectory; unshaded = no call (chains M, N and the splice / frozen-weight runs).

Design (from the Cross Train Experiment session): chain P = nano35-swe-v2-splice-minf-runMdata-to20-20260924 (MINF, chain M steps 1-20 replayed); chain Q = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runMdata-to20-20260924 (vLLM,

chain M steps 1-20 replayed); chain R = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runGdata-to10-20260924 (vLLM, chain G steps 1-10 replayed); chain R′ = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runGdata-to16-20260924 (vLLM, chain G steps 1-16

replayed); chain P′ = nano35-swe-v2-fromP20-lr0-minf-20260924 (MINF, frozen chain P step-20 weights, lr = 0); chain Q′ = nano35-swe-v2-fromP20-lr0-vllm-20260924 (vLLM, frozen chain P step-20 weights, lr = 0); chain

P‴ = nano35-swe-v2-fromP20-nvshmem-keepprefix-minf-20260925 (MINF, chain P step 20 resumed with normal training (lr 3e-6, optimizer state loaded), MINF generation with the prefix cache KEPT across weight updates

(invalidate_prefix_cache_on_weight_update=false), nvshmem refit); chain X = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runGdata-to10-maskX-rewarded-deep-20260927 (vLLM, chain G steps 1-10 replayed; masked replay, test: the 127

rewarded chain G rollouts that contain a >4,096-token think turn are given sample_mask 0 (rows kept in their groups)); chain Y = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runGdata-to10-maskY-random-rewarded-20260927 (vLLM, chain G

steps 1-10 replayed; masked replay, control: 127 random rewarded chain G rollouts without a deep think turn are masked instead); chain Z = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runMdata-to10-maskZ-punished-deep-20260927 (vLLM,

chain M steps 1-10 replayed; masked replay, mirror: chain M steps 1-10 with its 213 punished deep-think rollouts masked); chain AA = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runGdata-8to10-20260928 (vLLM, chain G steps 8-10

replayed; step-range ablation: only chain G steps 8-10 are replayed (unmasked); steps 1-7 and 11-25 are live vLLM); chain AB = nano35-swe-v2-splice-vllm-runGdata-1to7-20260928 (vLLM, chain G steps 1-7 replayed;

step-range ablation: chain G steps 1-7 replayed, live vLLM from step 8). All start from the base model with grpo.seed 42 and overlap_param_gather off; the MINF splice runs prefix caching on (inert during the

replay). Step k of a splice run trains on step-k rollouts of its source arm, exact 1:1. Questions: does a training history generated by the other engine change what an engine does once it generates for itself (P vs

chains G/I/J; Q vs chains M/N and run A / chain K; R and R′ vs chain G's own continuation); and on identical frozen weights, do the two engines loop at the same rate (P′ vs Q′; both vs P/Q whose weights keep

training); and does keeping the MINF prefix cache across refits change the MINF continuation (P‴ vs chain P steps 21-31, same prompts). Registered but without dumps yet (held): chain Y, chain Z, chain AB.

Frozen-weight arms P′ and Q′ (15 live steps each, 21-35, both ended at their 8 h walltime): all real weights verified bit-identical to chain P step 20 at steps 25/30/35; the only drift is the MoE router expert_bias

(24 buffers, about 0.001 per step, 0.015 max at step 35), same mechanism on both arms. Chain Q′ step 21 stalled ~20 min while the Gym code was missing from the bind mount and a few rollouts were retried.

Rendered 2026-09-28 11:50 from splice_loopshare.csv (splice runs exact from token dumps) and joint_loopshare.csv (comparators). Colors: reference categorical palette, fixed slot order; identity also carried by dash
pattern, marker shape, direct labels and this table.
